identity: Canonical model video ID and thumbnail URL joined to existing native image node in closest shared component or exact native context, with only one video identity in that scope
role: exact native attributed text matches a reviewed VideoData metadata/lockup title; exactly one model video and native text role; no typography or template revision inference
lifecycle: context and owner, exact entry/source, text element lease, original text, image binding identity and settings/backend generations rechecked before writes
presentation: native ASTextNode setAttributedText fixed v@:@ ABI, main queue, after original returns; styling retained; native gestures, models and loading untouched; original restored only within the same valid lease
interactive_text: reject protobuf command ranges and non-style attributed-string keys
existing_adapters: Existing verified row title roles retain ownership; generic adapter fills unresolved layouts and never mistakes a channel label for an original title already replaced upstream.
